summary: Iteration 26 — Phase 1/2 ASM features tested end-to-end. Backend GET /api/solution-finders/{id}/asm-entries works (9/9 pytest). Frontend Q2 RCA renders all 3 levels of ASM controls (Overall · across all PRIMARY concerns, per-concern, per-RCA). Deep-link from the 'ASM' pill correctly opens /tools/solution-matrix with prefill_title '[ASM]-RL <root cause text>' (verified for RL; OL/PL helpers use same util). Phase 2 'From ASM' picker opens modal, shows empty state with proper message, and populated state with Categories + Sources summary + Open button. Count badge appears on the bar. CRITICAL bugs found: (a) tapping 'Open' inside the From ASM picker (→ /tools/solution-matrix?id=<entry_id>) crashes with React 'Rendered fewer hooks than expected' due to an early `if (loading) return` at line 506 of solution-matrix.tsx BEFORE useMemo/useState declared later at lines 678 and 500-503; (b) VoiceInput.tsx still imported `Audio` from `expo-av` while the body used `useAudioRecorder`/`RecordingPresets`/`AudioModule`/`setAudioModeAsync` without imports — every eg-* tool crashed with 'useAudioRecorder is not defined' on load — FIXED by replacing the import with the correct expo-audio imports. Regression bug observed (likely pre-existing): SF loaded by id renders concerns text only, but RCAs/solutions never display because frontend Concern/RootCause types use `id` while backend persists `concern_id`/`rca_id`/`sol_id` — no field remap on load. Font widget at bottom:96 verified above bottom action bars (no overlap with Next/Save).

ui_bugs.issue: Rules-of-Hooks violation: `if (loading) return <Loading/>` at line 506 is before useState hooks at lines 500-503 are followed by useMemo `aggregatedActions` at line 678 (and useState at lines 500-503 are actually declared between the conditional return and earlier hooks). Opening solution-matrix with `?id=<entry_id>` (i.e., the Phase 2 'Open' button) sets loading=true, then false, triggering 'Rendered fewer hooks than expected. This may be caused by an accidental early return statement.' Page is blank. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-matrix.tsx:506

Loaded SF (`?id=...`) renders only top-level concern text. Per-concern RCAs and solutions never appear because frontend types use `id`/`concern_id` but backend persists `concern_id`/`rca_id`/`sol_id`. `rcasFor(c.id)` returns [] because hydrated concerns have `concern_id` (undefined `id`). Likely pre-existing but blocks Phase 2 testing of per-RCA/Solution From ASM at the rca/solution level. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/solution-finder.tsx:57,58,139,705

action_items: Fix solution-matrix.tsx Rules-of-Hooks violation: move the `if (loading) return ...` guard AFTER ALL hook declarations (useState/useMemo/useEffect). Specifically, the early return at line 506 must be moved below the useMemo `aggregatedActions` at line 678 (and any other hooks declared later in the component body). This unblocks Phase 2 'Open' navigation.

Add hydration normalization in solution-finder.tsx loadEntry: when backend returns concerns/root_causes/solutions, remap `concern_id` → `id` (and keep `concern_id` for cross-refs), `rca_id` → `id`, `sol_id` → `id`. Or refactor types to use `concern_id`/`rca_id`/`sol_id` directly throughout the renderer. Without this, saved SFs render blank from step 3 onward.
Remove `expo-av` from /app/frontend/package.json dependencies and run `yarn install` to complete the migration; verify app still bundles.
Fix the 'unique key prop' warning in SimpleSolutionFinder list rendering.

Optional retest: confirm `Open` from From ASM picker lands on a fully-populated ASM after the hooks fix; confirm `[ASM]-PL <concern>` and `[ASM]-OL Overall` deep-links once SF load hydration is fixed (needed to exercise per-concern/RCA/sol levels after reload).

rca_of_issue: 1) solution-matrix.tsx:506 has `if (loading) return <Loading/>;` placed BEFORE the useMemo `aggregatedActions` at line 678 and several useStates around lines 500-503. When Phase 2 'Open' navigates with `?id=<entry_id>`, loadEntry sets loading=true then false, causing React to render a different number of hooks across renders → 'Rendered fewer hooks than expected'. Fix: move the loading guard AFTER all hook declarations, OR render <Loading/> as an inline early branch inside JSX (after the hook block). 2) VoiceInput.tsx was importing the wrong package — replaced `import { Audio } from 'expo-av';` with `import { useAudioRecorder, RecordingPresets, AudioModule, setAudioModeAsync } from 'expo-audio';` and restarted expo. eg-aim now loads cleanly with the Voice Input button visible. 3) Concern/RootCause hydration mismatch — frontend defines `id` field on its types and renders via `c.id`/`r.id`, but backend stores `concern_id`/`rca_id`/`sol_id`; loadEntry assigns the raw payload arrays directly without remapping, so on reload the lookups all return empty.
